# Journalism Statistics v1.5.12

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on statistical calculations.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [addClusters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/addClusters.md): addClusters function
- [addMahalanobisDistance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/addMahalanobisDistance.md): addMahalanobisDistance function
- [addZScore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/addZScore.md): addZScore function
- [euclidianDistance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/euclidianDistance.md): euclidianDistance function
- [generateCirPath](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/generateCirPath.md): generateCirPath function
- [generateGbmPath](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/generateGbmPath.md): generateGbmPath function
- [getCholeskyMatrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getCholeskyMatrix.md): getCholeskyMatrix function
- [getCirParameters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getCirParameters.md): getCirParameters function
- [getCorrelatedShocks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getCorrelatedShocks.md): getCorrelatedShocks function

- [getCovarianceMatrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getCovarianceMatrix.md): getCovarianceMatrix function
- [getGbmParameters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getGbmParameters.md): getGbmParameters function
- [getMahalanobisDistance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-statistics/v1.5.12/docs/functions/getMahalanobisDistance.md): getMahalanobisDistance function
